services.desc: ANDREW RAFACZ is thrilled to announce Sophia Heymans, Xiaohan Jiang, Ann Toebbe, an exhibition of new and recent paintings from the three artists, in Galleries One & Two. The exhibition opens Thursday, September 17th and continues through Saturday, October 31st, 2026. The gallery will host artist-led tours of the exhibition with Xiaohan Jiang and Ann Toebbe on Saturday, September 19th and Sophia Heymans on Saturday, October 31st. Sophia Heymans, Xiaohan Jiang, Ann Toebbe surveys the work of three contemporary painters who are connected by their dedication to world-building, through unique approaches to composition and a focus on material. blurb: ANDREW RAFACZ is a leading contemporary art gallery based in Chicago. Founded in 2002, the gallery has presented-often for the first time in Chicago-prescient exhibitions by an international roster of artists for more than two decades. The gallery represents artists from a wide spectrum of backgrounds and identities working in many mediums, connected by their respective dedication to a thoughtful, defining practice.
